findings.title: Regression: on an upright tablet (768x1024) the lowered news chip lies on top of STUDENTS and RECRUIT, and a tap on them goes to the chip
findings.detail: The new .news-down rule puts the chip at bottom: calc(24px + var(--ico-h, 80px) + 20px), which assumes ONE row of icons on the bottom gutter. At 701-1179 px wide with more than 480 px of height (768x1024, and any 1024x768-like width) the dock is a 2 x 2 grid (home.css 'narrower landscape screens' rule), two rows of 76 px whose top is at y 844, so the chip (y 832-900 with two lines, 844-900 with one) sits on the top row. Also --ico-h is declared on .home-dock, not on the chip's host, so the var never reaches .home-news-host and the 80 px fallback is always used. It happens for exactly the pictures the fix was for: kinu-scene and marumi-scene at 768x1024. At the centre of STUDENTS elementFromPoint is the chip; a real click on STUDENTS opened the chip's own target (the login-gift modal on one run, Commissions on another), and RECRUIT's centre is not the icon either. Her face is fixed, but two of the four main icons cannot be used. e2e/lobby-illustrations.mjs passes because it only runs the controls tap check on the default stands, not over full illustrations. Fix ideas: place the lowered chip from the dock's real top (e.g. lowerNews sets a --dock-top from dock.offsetTop, or the dock publishes its height on .home), keep it clear of CO-OP and the plate, and add an 'every home control takes a tap at its centre' check to the full-illustration pass of e2e/lobby-illustrations.mjs.

findings.title: Picking backgrounds quickly can leave the home showing the wrong picture and girl (an older, slower show wins)
findings.detail: artStage.show() has no 'superseded' check: every call builds its layer, awaits its pictures, then replaces the scene. The picker stays open after a pick (bgPicker.js tile onclick commits and repaints), so tapping one tile then another is natural; when the first picture is still downloading and the second is cached, the second shows first and the first then replaces it. The save says the second (secretary and lobbyBg), the home shows the first girl's picture (home.current() reports her) until the next change or a reload. lobby.js showSecretary's news-wait guard (currentBg === bg.id) is right, but lowerNews then judges whatever picture actually won. The same code is in feature/ui-v2's artStage.js, so it predates this round, but it is a live logic fault of this home. Fix: a token in show() (const t = ++showToken; after the awaits, if (t !== showToken) return).

findings.title: lowerNews measures the chip mid-entrance and can miss her face on a fresh load
findings.detail: lowerNews reads the chip with getBoundingClientRect, which includes the entrance slide (translate -12 px when the picture arrives), and the chip's one-line height; uiBoxes deliberately uses the laid-out (offset) box and the two-line height. On a fresh load at 768x1024 with motion allowed and marumi-scene picked, the chip stays at the top with its pager 3 px into her face core (chip right 344, core left 341); any resize then lowers it. Under Reduce motion the same load lowers it correctly. Fix: measure with the same laid-out box and two-line height as uiBoxes.
findings.evidence: probe-edge2.mjs B2: 'motion=true marumi-scene: down=false; at reveal {x:12, anims: running, translate: -12px}; after a resize event down=true, clear=true'; motion=false: down=true.

findings.title: Hide UI, then a resize (a tablet turned and turned back), then restore: the chip comes back at the top over her face
findings.detail: refold -> lowerNews runs on the resize while the UI is hidden: it removes .news-down and returns early (ui-hidden). setHidden(false) only calls stage.relayout(), never lowerNews, so the chip is back at the top while the picture cannot pan. A store-change redraw (drawAll + relayout) also never re-runs lowerNews. Fix: run lowerNews (or refold) in setHidden(false) and after the redraw on a store change.
